g.text: Option desk - Overall Architecture (eight ways in, one set of artifacts out)
shell - everything that touches the outside world
engine - the numbers, standard library only, no network
THE ONLY IMPORT OF THE ENGINE
- Claude Code: skills + commands + agents + MCP
- a missing number is never guessed:
iv: null is counted, not defaulted
an audit found one command importing
the engine directly. Harmless at runtime,
still routed back through the bridge:
an invariant with exceptions is not one.
in memory. Every step is a file,
so any step can be re-run,

engine computes through the single bridge
dashboard renders what is on disk
